# New renderings — odyssey-107 (22.101–194)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| σάκος (22.101, 110, 122, 144, 184) | "shield" | "shield" | "buckler", "targe"; the plural σάκε’ is "shields" |
| κυνέη (22.102, 111, 123, 145) | "helmet" | "helmet" | "cap", "head-piece"; τρυφάλεια (22.183, derivation unknown) is "helm" in `l` and "helmet" in `i` |
| πάγχαλκος (22.102, of a helmet) | "all of bronze" | "all of bronze" | "all-bronze", "of solid bronze", "wholly bronze"; follows the shipped κυνέη πάγχαλκος "a helmet all of bronze" (odyssey-091) |
| κυνέας χαλκήρεας ἱπποδασείας (22.111 = 22.145) | "helmets, bronze-fitted, horse-haired" | "bronze-fitted helmets thick with horsehair" | "plumed", "crested" alone; χαλκήρης keeps "bronze-fitted" as in the table's χαλκήρεα δοῦρα |
| ἱππουρις · λόφος (22.124) | "horse-tailed" · "crest" | "with its horsetail plume" · "crest" | "plumed" alone, "horsehair" for ἵππουρις (reserved for ἱπποδάσεια) |
| τετραθέλυμνον (22.122; θέλυμνα uncertain) | "four-layered" | "four-layered" (+ note: meaning not known) | "four-ply", "four-folded", "with four foundations" |
| εὔτυκτος (22.123) | "well-made" | "well-made" | "well-wrought" (reserved for τετυγμένος) |
| ἄλκιμα δοῦρε δύω κεκορυθμένα χαλκῷ (22.125) | "two sturdy spears, armed with bronze" | "two sturdy spears, armed with bronze" (+ note: κεκορυθμένα from κόρυς 'helmet') | "valiant spears", "bronze-tipped" |
| τεύχεα καλά (22.114, 162) | "fine armour" | "fine armour" | "fair armour" (reserved for κάλλιμα, περικαλλής), "beautiful"; follows the table's κλυτὰ τεύχεα "famous armour" |
| ἱφθίμῳ κρατί (22.123) | "his mighty head" | "his mighty head" | "stout", "sturdy"; follows the table's ἴφθιμος "mighty" |
| ὀρσοθύρη (22.126, 132; sense of the first element uncertain) | "raised door" | "raised door" (+ note: kind of opening not known) | "back-door", "postern", "ventilator" (each picks a guess) |
| λαύρη (22.128, 137) | "passage" | "passage" | "lane", "alley", "street" |
| σανίδες εὖ ἀραρυῖαι (22.128) | "boards ... well fitted" | "well-fitted boards" | follows the table's σανίς "boards" (21.137); ἀραρυῖα is "fitted" as in the table's ἀραρυῖαν |
| ἐφορμή (22.130) | "way of attack" | "way to attack from" | "assault", "rush", "approach" |
| τοῖς δ’ Ἀγέλεως μετέειπεν, ἔπος πάντεσσι πιφαύσκων (whole-line speech introduction, 22.131) | "And among them Agelaus spoke, making known a word to all:" | "Then Agelaus spoke among them, making his word known to all:" | "answered", "addressed" (reserved for ἠμείβετο / προσέειπε); μετέειπεν keeps "spoke among" |
| οὐκ ἂν δή τις ... ἀναβαίη (22.132, negative potential question as proposal) | "would not someone go up" | "could not someone go up" | "will no one go up", "let someone go up" |
| ὤκιστα (22.133) | "most swiftly" | "as quickly as possible" | "very fast", "at once" |
| οὔ πως ἔστ’ (22.136) | "in no way is it possible" | "it cannot be done" | "it is impossible", "no way" |
| διοτρεφές (vocative, 22.136; Ἀγέλαε διοτρεφές) | "Zeus-nurtured one" | "Zeus-nurtured one" | follows the table's διοτρεφές (10.266) |
| θύρετρα (22.137) | "doors" | "doors" | "doorways", "gates" |
| ἀργαλέον στόμα λαύρης (22.137) | "grievous is the mouth of the passage" | "the mouth of the passage is grievous" | "troublesome", "hard"; follows the table's ἀργαλέος "grievous" |
| ἄλκιμος (of a man, 22.138) | "valiant" | "valiant" | "sturdy" (reserved for the spear, ἄλκιμον ἔγχος) |
| θωρηχθῆναι (22.139) | "to arm yourselves" | "to arm yourselves" | "to be breastplated", "to put on mail" |
| ῥῶγες (22.143; sense of the building feature not known) | "clefts" | "clefts" (+ note: what part of the hall is meant is not known) | "passages", "narrow ways", "corners" |
| πόλεμον κακόν (22.152) | "an evil war" | "an evil fight" | "a bad war", "a wicked war" (the table renders κακός "evil" in κακὰ κήδεα) |
| Μελανθεύς (22.152, 159) beside Μελάνθιος | "Melantheus" | "Melanthius" (+ note: second form of the same name) | "Melantheus" in `i` |
| ἀγκλίνας (22.156, = ἀνακλίνας) | "left leaning open" | "left ... ajar" | "left unlocked", "left unbarred" |
| σκοπός (22.156) | "watcher" | "lookout" | "spy", "guard" |
| θύρην ἐπίθες (22.157) | "put to the door" | "shut the door" | "close", "bar" |
| κεῖνος ἀΐδηλος ἀνήρ (22.165; ἀΐδηλος either "destroying" or "unseen") | "that ruinous man" | "that ruinous man" (+ note: sense disputed) | "baleful", "invisible", "accursed" (each picks one guess) |
| ὀΐω · ὀϊόμεθα · ὀΐομαι (22.140, 159, 165) | "I suppose" (140) · "I suspect" (159, 165) | same | "I think", "I guess" |
| σὺ δέ μοι νημερτὲς ἐνίσπες (22.166) | "and you, tell me unerringly" | "but you, tell me unerringly" | "tell me truly", "tell me without error" (see the table's νημερτής) |
| ὑπερβασίας (plural, 22.168; the table has ὑπερβασίη "overstepping" / "transgression") | "oversteppings" | "transgressions" | "insolence", "outrages" |
| σχήσομεν ἔντοσθεν μεγάρων (22.172) | "will hold back within the halls" | "will hold ... back inside the halls" | "restrain", "keep in" |
| ἀποστρέψαντε ... ὕπερθεν (22.173) | "having twisted back ... above" | "twist ... back over him" | "turn back", "bend", "pinion" |
| σανίδας δ’ ἐκδῆσαι ὄπισθε (22.174; picture uncertain) | "to tie boards on behind" | "fasten boards on behind" (+ note: what is meant is not clear) | "bind him to a board" (silently picks one guess) |
| σειρὴν πλεκτήν (22.175, 192) | "plaited rope" | "plaited rope" | "twisted cord", "braided cable" |
| κίον’ ἀν’ ὑψηλὴν ἐρύσαι πελάσαι τε δοκοῖσιν (22.176 = 22.193, infinitive and finite) | "up the high pillar to haul and to bring near the beams" | "haul him up the high pillar and bring him close to the beams" | "drag", "lift"; keeps the same verbs as 22.193 ἔρυσαν πέλασάν τε |
| χαλεπὰ ἄλγεα (22.177) | "harsh pains" | "harsh pains" | "hard", "grievous" (reserved for λυγρός / ἀργαλέος); follows the table's χαλεπός "harsh" |
| ὥς κεν δηθὰ ζωὸς ἐών (22.177) | "so that for long, alive" | "so that ... for a long time, alive" | "while still alive", "at length" |
| λαθέτην δέ μιν ἔνδον ἐόντα (22.179) | "escaped his notice as he was within" | "escaped his notice while he was inside" | "unnoticed", "without his seeing" |
| μυχὸν κάτα (22.180) | "down in the recess" | "in the innermost part" | "in the corner", "in the depths" |
| σταθμοῖσι (22.181) | "doorposts" | "doorposts" | "pillars", "jambs" |
| γέρον (neuter, of a shield, 22.184) | "old" | "old" | "ancient", "aged" |
| πεπαλαγμένον ἄζῃ (22.184; ἄζη "dry dirt") | "spattered with grime" | "spattered with grime" | "mould", "dust", "rust" |
| Λαέρτεω ἥρωος (22.185) | "of the hero Laertes" | "that had belonged to the hero Laertes" | follows the table's ἥρως "the hero" |
| κουρίζων (22.185) | "as a youth" | "when he was young" | "as a boy", "in his prime" |
| ῥαφαὶ ἱμάντων λέλυντο (22.186) | "the seams of the straps were undone" | "the stitching of the straps had come undone" | "the thongs had rotted", "had burst" |
| κουρίξ (22.188) | "by the hair" | "by the hair" | "by the forelock", "by the head" |
| ἀχνύμενον κῆρ (22.188) | "grieving in heart" | "grieving in his heart" | "heavy-hearted", "troubled in spirit" |
| θυμαλγέϊ δεσμῷ (22.189) | "a heart-grieving bond" | "a bond that grieved the heart" | "painful bond" (reserved for ἀργαλέος "grievous"), "cruel bonds" |
| διαμπερές (22.190) | "right through" | "very thoroughly" | "tight", "securely" |
| τὸν δ’ ἐπικερτομέων προσέφης, Εὔμαιε συβῶτα (22.194; second-person speech-introduction with a participle of taunting) | "Him, taunting, you addressed, Eumaeus the swineherd:" | "Taunting him, you said to him, Eumaeus the swineherd:" | "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο / ἀπαμειβόμενος), "mocking"; keeps the pattern of the table's τὸν δ’ ἀπαμειβόμενος προσέφης, Εὔμαιε συβῶτα (14.55) |
